flows.title: Stage review: run-folder contract, and review/server.py importing a run and writing a decision

assertions.expected: tests.test_stage_review passes: run-folder schema, chunking title check, export/import, decision files, gold rank and variant validation
review/server.py on a free loopback port imports an exported fixture run zip, lists it and serves its view with every candidate
A new run's zip whose view.json names the already imported run is refused with 400 for its view.json and adds no run
A decision from a foreign Origin is refused with 403; a same-origin decision writes <run-id>.md and .json under review/decisions and its prompt points at the .md

flows.title: Consultant asks one question and opens the original evidence in a browser

assertions.expected: The served app shows the JupyterHub sign-in entry; signing in through the fake hub opens the consultant page with that account in the header
Selecting a document and asking returns a grounded fake-provider answer whose single generation attempt settles
One click on the first evidence button opens its quote in the evidence panel
The evidence panel's original download is byte-identical to a managed source file

flows.title: Two requests with the same question stay separately reviewable from the history

assertions.expected: Two submissions of the same question appear as two separate history choices
Selecting the older request in the history and clicking its evidence once opens that evidence

flows.title: Verifier freezes a run and generates from it in a browser

assertions.expected: A free search-only verifier run is frozen and shown with its evidence and maximum estimate
Generating from the frozen run completes with one generation attempt whose reservation does not exceed the displayed maximum

flows.title: Six concurrent browser sessions share one budget

assertions.expected: Six sessions signed in as different hub users each submit once; every request finishes attributed to its own account with at most one generation attempt and no open reservation
While the first session's request is running, another session's budget row shows the shared reservation within the polling interval

flows.title: Exhausted cap: audited owner action, blocked paid answers, working free routes

assertions.expected: An owner adjustment without a reason is refused and records nothing
An owner adjustment with a reason (CLI adjust) is recorded and appears in the audit log (CLI audit)
At the exhausted cap a consultant's paid question is blocked before any attempt and the cap warning is shown
At the cap an original still downloads, and polling and a reload create no attempt

flows.title: Keyboard use, focus, contrast and narrow layout

assertions.expected: With the keyboard only, a document is selected, a question typed and submitted, and the answer's first evidence opened
Every control reached by Tab shows a visible focus indicator
Every visible text on 질문하기, 검증 and 데이터셋 만들기 has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background
At a 390 px wide viewport none of the three pages scrolls horizontally and the answer status is shown as text

flows.title: A newer GitHub main shows the header update banner; its button fades during paid work and only a confirmation requests the update

assertions.expected: With a stand-in GitHub whose main is two commits ahead, the header shows the banner with both commit titles, the running and latest commits, and an enabled, fully opaque 업데이트 button
While a paid question runs the button is disabled with reduced opacity and the reason is shown; after the request ends it is enabled and opaque again without a reload
업데이트 opens a dialog warning of the restart, sign-out and re-entering API keys; 취소 closes it, sends no POST /api/update and writes no marker
Confirming sends one POST /api/update, writes only the marker (requester, time, running commit) and shows the updating state
When the updater records a rollback, the waiting page shows it and the next visitor sees that the last update was rolled back
